description: Screening weights and tier thresholds. Implements Section 4 of the architecture doc. Max composite = 40.

field_alignment.what: Match to legal / policy / clean energy / sustainability law / real estate / legal tech.

location_fit.what: Berkeley/SF/Oakland/Bay Area/remote score high; other locations low unless exceptional.

timing.what: Deadline proximity + start-date alignment with the academic calendar.

compensation.what: Paid > stipend > unpaid, adjusted for cost of living.

growth_signal.what: Brand recognition, skill development, network value.

location.note: Preferred: Berkeley, SF, Oakland, Remote. Bay Area (~15mi Berkeley) acceptable. Portland and other out-of-area locations score low.
